name: UX Business Modeling & Product Strategy
description: Aligning user experience with business models: Business Model Canvas, Lean Canvas, Value Proposition Canvas, competitor analysis, unit economics, and Product-Led Growth (PLG).

subskills.name: Business Model Canvas (Osterwalder)
subskills.description: Mapping product vision across 9 building blocks: value propositions, customer segments, channels, revenue streams, and cost structures.

subskills.name: Competitive UX Benchmarking & Feature Matrix
subskills.description: Analyzing competitor flows, heuristic benchmarking, and feature differentiation matrices.

subskills.name: Value Proposition Design & Customer Profile Mapping
subskills.description: Mapping customer jobs, pains, and gains to product pain relievers and gain creators.

subskills.name: Lean Canvas (Ash Maurya)
subskills.description: Fast-iteration canvas focusing on problem, solution, unique value proposition, unfair advantage, and early adopters.

subskills.name: Inspirator Analysis & Cross-Industry Analogues
subskills.description: Drawing analog UX patterns from non-competing industries (e.g. applying gaming onboarding to fintech).

subskills.name: UX SWOT Analysis
subskills.description: Assessing product experience Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats against market trends.

subskills.name: Porter's Five Forces & Industry UX Defensibility
subskills.description: Evaluating industry competitiveness, buyer power, substitution threat, and switching costs in UX design.

subskills.name: SaaS Unit Economics & Monetization UX
subskills.description: Aligning UX design with SaaS unit economics: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), payback period, and churn reduction.

subskills.name: Product-Led Growth (PLG) & Time-to-Value (TTV)
subskills.description: Designing frictionless self-service onboarding, virality loops, freemium-to-paid conversion thresholds, and minimizing TTV.

github.signal: Product strategy docs, Value Proposition Canvas files, and pricing tier UX components

cv.signal: Formulated Lean Canvases and mapped Value Proposition Canvases driving product-market fit for B2B SaaS
Led Product-Led Growth (PLG) UX redesign decreasing Time-to-Value from 3 days to 8 minutes and boosting LTV/CAC

linkedin.signal: Endorsements in Product Strategy, Business Model Innovation, Product-Led Growth, and SaaS Unit Economics

junior.description: Maps Osterwalder Business Model Canvases, analyzes competitor flows, and matches pains to gain creators.

mid.description: Builds Lean Canvases for rapid validation, conducts cross-industry inspirator analyses, and executes SWOT assessments.

senior.description: Aligns product UX with SaaS unit economics (LTV/CAC), optimizes PLG self-service conversion, and builds switching cost defensibility.
